wiring: F, recursive natural tower, global chart (ancestral transport from level 0 with rule R1)

conventions.port_labels: template labels of oph_defects.fedgeom / RL/work/S3/s0_lib.py; W in the labels of the recursive natural tower (s0_lib.natural_tower(level, (0, 11, 5), r))
conventions.global_label: global_label[c][p] is the port of the base icosahedron whose axis port p of carrier c has; every carrier is a parallel copy of the base icosahedron
conventions.spinor: chi+(n) = (cos(theta/2), exp(i phi) sin(theta/2)); complex numbers are [re, im]
conventions.z_rule: z of the hop from port p of c to port q of c' = phase of <chi(u_G')|chi(u_G)>, G and G' the global labels of the two ports; G and G' are adjacent ports on every glue seam

port_axes_note: ambient axis of port p of carrier c = template_port_axes[global_label[c][p]]
